rule_set_name: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — SIH26034 Full Rulebook
disclaimer: These rules are modelled on the Legal Metrology Act, 2009 and Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (GSR 202(E) dated 07.03.2011), including amendments up to August 2026. Secondary-source amendments are flagged. Verify all effective dates and amendment wording against egazette.gov.in and consumeraffairs.nic.in before production deployment. This is a prototype — not a substitute for qualified legal advice.
amendments_applied: GSR 748(E) 24.10.2011 — wording changes to Rule 12(6) and withdrawal of provisos
GSR 881(E) 02.12.2025 — pan masala excluded from Rule 26(a) micro-package exemption [secondary source]
Amendment Rules 2025 (Oct) — medical devices carve-out from Rule 7/8 [secondary source]
Amendment Rules 2026 (13.02.2026) + Second Amendment 2026 (27.04.2026) — Rule 6(10A) e-commerce CoO [secondary source, not yet in force]

categories.mandatory_declarations: Core mandatory declarations on every retail package (Rule 6)
categories.quantity_measurement: Net quantity, unit validity, standard pack sizes (Rules 11-13, Schedules II-IV)
categories.display_visibility: Font size, PDP placement, contrast, language (Rules 7-9)

exemption_categories.food: Food articles governed by FSSAI/Food Safety and Standards Act — manufacturer/date/consumer-care checks route to food-law module
exemption_categories.bidi: Bidi packages exempt from MRP (Rule 6(1)(e) proviso) and date (Rule 6(1)(d) proviso)
exemption_categories.incense_stick: Incense sticks exempt from date declaration (Rule 6(1)(d) proviso)
exemption_categories.lpg_admin_price: 14.2 kg / 5 kg PSU-marketed domestic LPG cylinders exempt from MRP and date declarations
exemption_categories.seed: Seed packages governed by Seeds Act, 1966 — date check routes to Seeds Act module
exemption_categories.medical_device: Medical device packages — font-size and PDP-placement rules superseded by Medical Devices Rules, 2017 (Amendment Rules Oct 2025)
exemption_categories.pan_masala: Pan masala packages CANNOT use the ≤10 g/ml micro-package exemption (Second Amendment Rules 2025, effective 01.02.2026)
exemption_categories.industrial_institutional: Packages for industrial/institutional consumers are outside Chapter II scope (Rule 3)
exemption_categories.above_25kg: Packages above 25 kg / 25 L (except cement/fertiliser ≤50 kg) are outside Chapter II (Rule 3)
exemption_categories.restaurant_hotel: Fast-food packages from a restaurant/hotel are exempt (Rule 26(b))
exemption_categories.drugs_price_control: Drugs under Drugs (Price Control) Order 1995 are exempt (Rule 26(c))
exemption_categories.agri_above_50kg: Agricultural produce packages above 50 kg are exempt (Rule 26(d))

rules.title: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Name & Address
rules.description: Every retail package shall bear the name and complete postal address of the manufacturer; if packer differs from manufacturer, both; if imported, also the importer's name and address.
rules.requirement: Manufacturer/packer/importer name and complete address (with city/state or PIN) must be present and legible.
rules.penalty_amount: Fine up to ₹25,000 (1st offence), up to ₹50,000 (2nd), ₹50,000–₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year (3rd+)
rules.source_reference: Rule 6(1)(a), Rule 10 — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: Food articles governed by FSSAI — route to food-law module, skip this check for food category.

rules.title: Common / Generic Commodity Name
rules.description: Every package shall bear the common or generic name of the commodity. For multi-product packs, the name and quantity of each component must be declared.
rules.requirement: Common/generic commodity name must be present and legible on the principal display panel.
rules.source_reference: Rule 6(1)(b) — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

rules.title: Net Quantity Declaration
rules.description: Every package shall bear a declaration of net quantity in standard metric units. The declaration must use the correct unit family for the commodity type.
rules.requirement: Net quantity must be declared as a positive numeric value with a valid SI/metric unit (g, kg, ml, L, m, cm, N/nos, etc.). No vague qualifiers (minimum, about, approximately) allowed.
rules.source_reference: Rule 6(1)(c), Rule 12, Rule 13 — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: Rule 12(6) vague-qualifier ban broadened by GSR 748(E) 24.10.2011. Pan masala cannot use ≤10 g exemption per Second Amendment Rules 2025 (effective 01.02.2026).

rules.title: MRP Declaration (Wording & Format)
rules.description: Every package shall bear the Maximum Retail Price (MRP) inclusive of all taxes, in the prescribed wording. Paise rounding: below 50 paise → round to rupee; 50–95 paise → round to ₹0.50.
rules.requirement: MRP must be present as 'Maximum/Max. Retail Price Rs/₹… inclusive of all taxes' or 'MRP Rs/₹… incl. of all taxes'. Must be a positive numeric value.
rules.source_reference: Rule 6(1)(e), Rule 2(m) — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: Soft-drink returnable bottles may show MRP on crown cap (Rule 8(2)). Alcoholic beverages: State Excise law takes priority if it mandates MRP; if silent, these Rules apply.

rules.title: Date of Manufacture / Packing / Import
rules.description: Every package shall bear the month and year in which the commodity was manufactured, pre-packed, or imported.
rules.requirement: Month and year of manufacture/packing/import must be declared (MM/YYYY or month-name + year format).
rules.source_reference: Rule 6(1)(d) — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: Food articles date marking governed by FSSAI. Seed packages governed by Seeds Act, 1966. Cosmetics: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945. Expiry/best-before dates are NOT a Legal Metrology requirement.

rules.title: Consumer Care Contact Details
rules.description: Every package shall bear the name, address, and telephone number of the person/office to be contacted for consumer complaints. Email is required only if available.
rules.requirement: Consumer care block with name, address, and phone number must be present. Email address is optional.
rules.source_reference: Rule 6(2) — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: Phone is mandatory; email is conditional ('if available'). Absence of email alone is NOT a FAIL. Cannot verify if the phone number is live — flag as UNABLE TO VERIFY if OCR confidence is low.

rules.title: Country of Origin (Imported Goods)
rules.description: Imported packages must declare the country in which the commodity was manufactured or produced.
rules.requirement: Country of origin must be declared on all imported commodities. 'Made in [Country]' or equivalent wording required.
rules.source_reference: Rule 6(1)(a), Rule 10 — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: Rule 6(10A) (Amendment Rules 2026, effective 01.07.2027) will require e-commerce entities to provide searchable/sortable country-of-origin filter on imported product listings. This applies to listings, not physical packages, and is NOT YET IN FORCE.

rules.title: Net Quantity — Numeric Value Positive
rules.description: The numeric value in the net quantity declaration must be a positive number greater than zero.
rules.requirement: Net quantity numeric value must be > 0.
rules.source_reference: Rule 6(1)(c), Rule 11 — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

rules.title: MRP — Positive Numeric Value
rules.description: The MRP must contain a positive numeric price in Indian Rupees.
rules.requirement: MRP must be a positive numeric value greater than zero.
rules.source_reference: Rule 6(1)(e), Rule 2(m) — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

rules.title: Metric Unit Validity
rules.description: Only SI/metric units are permitted for net quantity declarations. Imperial units (lb, oz, gallon, inch, yard) are strictly prohibited. Non-metric counting units (dozen, score, gross, great-gross) are also banned.
rules.requirement: Only standard metric/SI units permitted. Banned: lb, oz, gallon, pint, yard, feet, inch, dozen, score, gross, great-gross.
rules.source_reference: Rule 13 — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: Count unit must be 'N' or 'U' per Rule 13. 'Dozen', 'score', 'gross', 'great-gross' are explicitly banned.

rules.title: Vague Quantity Qualifier Ban
rules.description: Rule 12(6) prohibits the use of vague or misleading words adjacent to the net quantity declaration. Words like 'minimum', 'about', 'approximately', 'average', 'not less than' are explicitly banned.
rules.requirement: Net quantity declaration must NOT contain vague qualifiers: 'minimum', 'min', 'about', 'approximately', 'approx', 'average', 'not less than', 'upto', 'up to', 'nearly', 'roughly'.
rules.source_reference: Rule 12(6) — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended by GSR 748(E) 24.10.2011)
rules.amendment_notes: Third Schedule commodities (soaps, lotions, creams) may legitimately carry 'when packed' qualifier per Rule 11(4) — do NOT flag as a vague-word violation.

rules.title: Standard Pack Size Conformity (Schedule II)
rules.description: Commodities listed in the Second Schedule (baby food, biscuits, bread, butter, cereals, coffee, tea, edible oils, milk powder, detergents, atta, salt, soaps, soft drinks, mineral water, cement, paints) must be packed only in the standard quantities listed in that Schedule.
rules.requirement: For Second Schedule commodities, declared net quantity must match a permitted standard pack size from Schedule II.
rules.penalty_amount: Fine ₹2,000 (Rule 32(2)) or higher if deliberate mis-declaration
rules.source_reference: Rule 5, Second Schedule — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: The 'non-standard size' declaration proviso was reportedly withdrawn w.e.f. 01.07.2012 per GSR 748(E) — verify current status before enforcing a hard FAIL. Flag as NEEDS_REVIEW if uncertain.

rules.title: Micro-Package Exemption Check (≤10 g/ml)
rules.description: Packages with net quantity ≤10 g or ≤10 ml are generally exempt from all Rule 6 declarations (Rule 26(a)). However, this exemption DOES NOT apply to pan masala (Second Amendment Rules 2025, effective 01.02.2026). Packages in the 10–20 g/ml band still need MRP and net quantity declared.
rules.requirement: If net quantity ≤10 g/ml AND commodity is NOT pan masala → package is EXEMPT from Rule 6 declarations. If pan masala → full declarations required regardless of size.
rules.source_reference: Rule 26(a), Second Amendment Rules 2025 (GSR 881(E) 02.12.2025) — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: Pan masala override: effective 01.02.2026. 10–20 g/ml band still requires MRP + net quantity (not full exemption). VERIFY this amendment against egazette.gov.in before production enforcement.

rules.title: MRP Wording — Tax Inclusive Clause
rules.description: The MRP declaration must include the phrase 'inclusive of all taxes' or an equivalent. Abbreviations such as 'incl. all taxes' or 'incl. of all taxes' are acceptable.
rules.requirement: MRP text must include 'inclusive of all taxes', 'incl. of all taxes', 'incl. tax', or equivalent wording.
rules.source_reference: Rule 2(m), Rule 6(1)(e) — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: Exact required wording per Rule 2(m): 'Maximum/Max. retail price Rs/₹… inclusive of all taxes'. Abbreviation 'incl. all taxes' widely accepted in practice.

rules.title: MRP Anti-Tampering (No Obliteration / Sticker Override)
rules.description: No dealer may obliterate, alter, or deface the printed MRP on a package. A sticker showing a LOWER MRP is permissible but must not obscure the original printed MRP. Stickers showing a HIGHER MRP than printed are illegal.
rules.requirement: Printed MRP must be visible and unaltered. No sticker should obscure the original MRP. Any correction sticker must show a LOWER price only.
rules.source_reference: Rule 6(3)–(4), Rule 18(5)–(6) — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.automation_note: Computer vision only — detect sticker region vs. printed region. Confidence is low without training data. Flag as NEEDS_REVIEW rather than hard FAIL.
rules.amendment_notes: Rule 6(3): no individual sticker to alter/make a required declaration. Rule 6(4): sticker lowering MRP allowed if original MRP still visible. Rule 18(5): dealer shall not obliterate/alter printed MRP.

rules.title: Numeral Height — Net Quantity on PDP (Rule 7)
rules.description: The height of numerals used in the net quantity declaration on the Principal Display Panel must meet minimum thresholds per Table I (weight/volume) or Table II (length/area/number) of Rule 7.
rules.requirement: Numeral height: up to 200 g/ml → ≥1 mm (2 mm blown/molded); 200–500 g/ml → ≥2 mm (4 mm); above 500 g/ml → ≥4 mm (6 mm). For length/area: up to 100 cm² → 1 mm; 100–500 cm² → 2 mm; 500–2500 cm² → 4 mm; above 2500 cm² → 6 mm.
rules.automation_note: Requires calibrated image measurement — accuracy depends on camera angle, resolution, and availability of a known reference dimension in the image.
rules.source_reference: Rule 7(2)–(3), Tables I & II — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: Medical device packages: font-size rules of the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 apply instead (Amendment Rules Oct 2025). Rule 7 does not apply to medical devices.

rules.title: PDP Placement — All Declarations on Principal Display Panel
rules.description: All mandatory declarations must appear on the Principal Display Panel (PDP) of the package. The net quantity declaration must have clear space of at least 1× numeral height above/below and 2× numeral height left/right.
rules.requirement: All required declarations must be on the PDP. Net quantity must have prescribed clear space surrounding it.
rules.automation_note: Requires PDP-region segmentation model. Flag as NEEDS_REVIEW rather than hard FAIL.
rules.source_reference: Rule 8 — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: Returnable soft-drink bottles: MRP may appear on crown cap instead of bottle (Rule 8(2)). Medical devices: PDP-placement mandate superseded by Medical Devices Rules 2017 (Oct 2025 amendment).

rules.title: Legibility — Contrast & Language
rules.description: All declarations must be legible, prominent, and in Hindi (Devanagari) or English. MRP and net-quantity numerals must contrast conspicuously with the background. Declarations must not require reading through a liquid.
rules.requirement: Declarations must be in Hindi or English (both optional). MRP and net-quantity numerals must have adequate contrast ratio against background. No declaration may require reading through a liquid.
rules.automation_note: OCR confidence score used as proxy for legibility. Language detection via OCR character set. Contrast ratio computable from image pixel values.
rules.source_reference: Rule 9 — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: Blown/molded glass or plastic exempt from contrast rule. Handwritten declarations are allowed if clear. Outer transparent wrapper need not repeat declarations.

rules.title: Wholesale Package Declarations (Rule 24)
rules.description: Wholesale packages must carry the name and address of the manufacturer/importer/packer, commodity identity, and either the total number of retail packages contained or the net quantity in standard units.
rules.requirement: Wholesale packages: manufacturer/packer/importer name+address, commodity identity, and total count or net quantity must be declared.
rules.source_reference: Rule 24 — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: Wholesale packages have a reduced declaration set vs. retail. Not required if another law already mandates an equivalent wholesale declaration.

rules.title: Import / Export Package Re-labelling
rules.description: Export packages intended for domestic re-sale in India must be re-packed or re-labelled to full Chapter II compliance before being offered for sale. If a commodity is manufactured outside India but packed in India, both the foreign manufacturer's details AND the Indian packer/importer's name+address must appear on the PDP.
rules.requirement: For imported packages: both foreign manufacturer and Indian importer name+address on PDP. For diverted export packages: must be re-labelled before domestic sale.
rules.penalty_amount: Per Act general offence provisions; seizure risk
rules.source_reference: Rule 10(1) 2nd proviso, Rule 25 — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: Rule 25: an export package sold domestically without re-labelling is a seizure-triggering violation. Rule 10(1): Indian packer/importer address must be on the PDP for India-packed imports.

rules.title: Manufacturer Registration Status (External DB)
rules.description: Every manufacturer, packer, or importer must be registered with the Director or Controller of Legal Metrology (Rules 27–30). Registration status cannot be verified from a package photo alone — requires access to the Legal Metrology registration register.
rules.requirement: Named manufacturer/packer/importer should be cross-checked against the Legal Metrology registration register (Rules 27–30).
rules.automation_note: Flag as 'Unable to Verify — Human Review Required' unless a machine-readable Legal Metrology registration API is available. Do NOT hard-FAIL based on inability to verify.
rules.source_reference: Rules 27–30 — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: Registration fee: ₹500 initial, ₹100 for alterations. Director/Controller must be applied to within 90 days of commencing pre-packing/import.

rules.title: No Sale Above MRP (Dealer Obligation)
rules.description: No dealer may sell a pre-packaged commodity at a price exceeding the declared MRP. This obligation is on the dealer and requires transaction price data — it cannot be verified from a package photo alone.
rules.requirement: Sale price must not exceed the declared MRP on the package.
rules.automation_note: Cannot be verified from a package image. Requires transaction/POS data. Always flag as UNABLE TO VERIFY from image alone.
rules.penalty_amount: Per Act general offence provisions — High priority enforcement action
rules.source_reference: Rule 18(2) — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.amendment_notes: Dealer-level obligation. MRP overcharging is independently prosecutable. Cannot detect from package image — POS data integration required for full enforcement.

rules.title: Font Size Compliance (Net Quantity)
rules.description: The numeral height for the net quantity declaration must meet the minimum legal requirement of 2.0 mm per Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 Table I.
rules.requirement: Net Quantity text height must be at least 2.0 mm.
rules.source_reference: Rule 7(2), Table I — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

rules.title: Font Size Compliance (MRP)
rules.description: The numeral height for the Maximum Retail Price (MRP) declaration must meet the minimum legal requirement of 2.0 mm for clear consumer visibility.
rules.requirement: MRP declaration font height must be at least 2.0 mm.
rules.source_reference: Rule 7, Rule 6(1)(e) — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

rules.title: Font Size Compliance (Manufacturer)
rules.description: The declaration of manufacturer, packer, or importer name and address must have a minimum letter height of 1.5 mm.
rules.requirement: Manufacturer name & address font height must be at least 1.5 mm.
rules.source_reference: Rule 7, Rule 6(1)(a) — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

rules.title: Barcode & GS1 Verification
rules.description: Product barcode/QR code is cross-referenced with the GS1 National Registry to verify authentic manufacturer registration, category match, and declared MRP compliance.
rules.requirement: Barcode must exist in GS1 Registry and match product manufacturer and MRP within ±5% tolerance.
rules.penalty_amount: Fine up to ₹25,000 (1st offence); Counterfeit prosecution
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology E-Commerce & Barcode Directives, GS1 India Standard

rules.title: Dual Language Compliance (Hindi / English)
rules.description: Every declaration on packaged commodities shall be in Hindi in Devanagari script or in English (Rule 9). Mandatory national sales declarations should provide dual language readability.
rules.requirement: Declarations must be legible in English or Hindi (Devanagari script) per Rule 9(1).
rules.source_reference: Rule 9(1) — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

rules.title: Anti-Tampering & MRP Integrity Verification
rules.description: No person shall alter, obliterate, or smudge any declaration, or paste any sticker over the Maximum Retail Price (MRP) or date of manufacture.
rules.requirement: Package must not exhibit adhesive stickers, overwritten ink, or smudged declarations over MRP or date.
rules.penalty_amount: Fine up to ₹50,000 (1st offence) and/or prosecution
rules.source_reference: Rule 18(2) & Section 18(2) — Legal Metrology Act, 2009
